settings.heading: Most Kids Are Missing Key Nutrients. Get Help in Just 2 Gummies.

settings.title: Stress & Mood Swings
settings.body: With Vitamin B6 for mood regulation and Vitamin B12 for energy balance, these gummies help support emotional stability.*

settings.title: Lack of Motivation
settings.body: Packed with Vitamin B1 for brain health and Vitamin B2 for cognitive support - to help your teen stay on track while they balance school, sports, and everything in between.*

settings.title: Bad Skin
settings.body: Vitamin A and Vitamin E support skin health, helping teens maintain a clear and balanced complexion.

settings.title: Weakened Immunity
settings.body: With immune-supporting Vitamin C and D3, plus key B vitamins that help keep their systems running smoothly. Our formula helps build a strong foundation to tackle whatever the day throws at them.

settings.title: Trouble Sleeping
settings.body: Vitamin D3 helps regulate melatonin, the hormone that controls sleep cycles. Combined with B6, it supports calmer bedtimes and better rest for growing toddlers.*

settings.title: Poor Sleep Habits
settings.body: Vitamin D3 and Magnesium work together to encourage restful sleep, so kids wake up refreshed and ready to conquer their goals.*

settings.title: Picky Eating
settings.body: Vitamin A and Vitamin B9 support cell growth and development, helping to fill in nutritional gaps that teens may have when they only want junk food or continue to skip meals.*
